q: Replication is a process of:
choices: Creating an exact copy (replica) of data
explain: **Replication = creating an exact copy (replica) of data**.

q: Replicating data within the same array or data center is called:
explain: **Local replication**. أما الـ **remote** فلموقع بعيد.

q: LUNs accessed by the production host are known as:
explain: **source LUNs / production LUNs / the source**.

q: LUNs where data is replicated are called:
explain: **Target LUNs = replicas**.

q: Updates made on the target replica:
explain: **updates on the target do not affect the source**.

q: Targets can be made identical to the source again through:
explain: **Targets can be incrementally resynchronized with the source**.

q: Using a local replica as an alternate source for backup:
choices: Reduces I/O load on production LUNs and eliminates backup windows
explain: **Alternate source for backup**: ضغط أقل على الـ production و**مفيش backup window**.

q: Which use of local replicas minimizes downtime (RTO) after a source failure?
explain: **Fast recovery**.

q: Testing application upgrades on a replica before applying them to the source is the use called:
explain: **Testing platform**.

q: Which is NOT a listed use of local replicas?
explain: الاستخدامات: **backup source، fast recovery، testing، migration**.

q: Why can a replica be inconsistent?
choices: Data still buffered in host memory was not written to disk before the replica was created
explain: البيانات اللي **لسه في الـ buffer** مش هتدخل الـ replica، فتبقى ناقصة.

q: A consistent replica means:
choices: The replica is larger than the source
All data buffered in the host has been written to disk before the replica is created
explain: ده تعريف **consistent replica**.

q: The primary requirement for all replication technologies is:
explain: **Consistency is the primary requirement for all replication technologies**.

q: The two types of local replication are:
explain: **Host-based** و **Storage array-based**. أما sync و async فدي **remote**.

q: In host-based replication:
choices: The array OS does all the work
The host uses its own CPU, memory and software to replicate
explain: **Host-based**: السيرفر هو اللي بيقرر وبيستخدم موارده.

q: Which host-based replication works at the file or folder level?
explain: **File System–Based**: ملفات وفولدرات، real-time أو scheduled.

q: A disadvantage of file system-based replication is that it:
choices: May not capture open or in-use files properly
explain: **May not capture files that are open or in-use**، و file level بس، و CPU زيادة.

q: LVM mirroring works at:
choices: Block level, duplicating every write to a secondary volume
explain: **Volume/Block-Based (LVM Mirroring)**: كل كتابة على الـ primary بتتكتب على الـ secondary.

q: An advantage of LVM mirroring is that it:
choices: Is transparent to applications and can replicate the full system including OS
explain: **Transparent to applications** و**ينسخ النظام كله**، بس بيستهلك CPU و memory و I/O.

q: Snapshot-based replication creates:
choices: A point-in-time copy of a volume or file system
explain: **Snapshot = point-in-time copy**، سريع في العمل والاسترجاع.

q: Storage array-based replication is performed by:
choices: The array operating system itself, without host CPU or memory
explain: **Array-based**: الـ OS بتاع الـ array، فأسرع وأقل استهلاكًا لموارد الـ host.

q: Which of the following is NOT a storage array-based local replication technique?
explain: الـ **LVM mirroring** ده **host-based**.

q: In full-volume mirroring, during the initial synchronization the target is:
explain: **During the initial sync, the target volume is inaccessible**.

q: After detachment, a full-volume mirror becomes a:
explain: **After detachment, it becomes a Point-in-Time (PIT) replica**.

q: When source and target are re-linked in full-volume mirroring:
choices: Only the changes are copied (incremental resynchronization)
The entire data is copied again
explain: **incremental resynchronization: only the changes are copied**.

q: A disadvantage of full-volume mirroring is that it:
choices: Requires storage capacity equal to the source
Depends on the source after detachment
explain: **Requires storage capacity equal to the source** والـ target مش متاح وقت الـ sync.

q: In full-volume mirroring, while attached, Source = Target; while detached, Source ≠ Target; after resynchronization:
explain: Attached (=) ← Detached (≠) ← Resync (**=**).

q: In pointer-based full-volume replication, the target device is:
choices: Immediately accessible after the session is activated
explain: **Target device is immediately accessible by the BC host after the replication session is activated**.

q: CoFA stands for:
explain: **CoFA = Copy on First Access** (deferred mode).

q: In CoFA mode:
choices: All data is copied immediately before use
Only blocks that are accessed (on source or target) are copied
explain: **Only the blocks that are accessed are copied**، والـ target متاح فورًا.

q: In CoFA, when a write is issued to the source for the first time after activation:
choices: The target is overwritten with new data first
The original data at that address is copied to the target, then the new data is written to the source
explain: البيانات **الأصلية بتتنسخ للـ target الأول**، فالـ target يحافظ على PIT.

q: In the full copy mode of pointer-based full-volume replication:
choices: The target is unavailable until the copy ends
A PIT copy is created instantly and all source data is copied to the target in the background
explain: **Full copy**: PIT فوري + نسخ كامل **في الخلفية**، والـ target متاح فورًا.

q: A disadvantage of pointer-based full-volume replication is that:
choices: Managing block pointers is slightly complex and performance may be affected by many writes
It cannot keep a PIT copy
explain: **Managing block pointers is complex** والأداء ممكن يتأثر.

q: In pointer-based virtual replication, the target:
choices: Holds pointers that reference data on the source instead of storing all data
Is a separate physical array always
explain: **The target holds pointers that reference the data on the source**.

q: CoFW stands for:
explain: **CoFW = Copy on First Write**.

q: On the first write in pointer-based virtual replication (CoFW):
choices: The original block is copied to a save location, then the modification is applied to the source
explain: **1. original block → save location · 2. modification applied to the source**.

q: If the source becomes invalid in pointer-based virtual replication:
choices: The target becomes the new source automatically
explain: **If the source becomes invalid, the target also becomes invalid**.

q: Pointer-based virtual replication is ideal for:
choices: Space efficiency, testing, and multiple lightweight replicas
explain: **Uses much less storage**، و**سريع جدًا**، ومثالي للـ testing.

q: Remote replication protects data against:
choices: Natural disasters, hardware failure, human errors, and ransomware
explain: بيحمي من **الكوارث، وأعطال الهاردوير، والأخطاء البشرية، والـ ransomware**.

q: Remote replication allows:
choices: Running operations from a disaster recovery (DR) site
explain: **Fast recovery، running operations from a DR site، minimum downtime and data loss**.

q: In synchronous replication, the write operation completes:
choices: Only when both the primary and remote sites confirm
explain: **Synchronous: completes only when both sides confirm**.

q: Synchronous remote replication provides:
explain: **Zero data loss (RPO = 0)**.

q: Synchronous replication is usually limited to:
explain: **Requires high bandwidth and is usually limited to short distances (<100–200 km)**.

q: A disadvantage of synchronous replication is:
choices: High cost and increased latency over long distances
explain: **High cost, increased latency over long distances**.

q: In asynchronous replication:
choices: Data is written to the primary first and sent to the remote site after a small delay
Data is written to both sites simultaneously
explain: **Async**: الأساسي الأول، وبعدين للبعيد بعد ثواني أو دقايق.

q: Which replication type works over long distances (even across countries) at lower cost?
explain: **Asynchronous**، بس **RPO > 0**.

q: In asynchronous replication, when is the host write acknowledged?
choices: Only after the remote target confirms
Immediately after writing to the source
explain: **(2) The write is immediately acknowledged to the host**، والنسخ للبعيد بعدين.

q: SAN-based remote replication happens at:
choices: The storage network level, controlled by the array or SAN software
explain: **at the storage network level, not at the server or application level**.

q: In SAN-based remote replication, data is typically replicated at the ______ level, sending only changed blocks.
explain: **replicated at the block level, meaning only the changed blocks are sent**.

q: Which type of SAN-based replication is space-efficient, faster, and supports incremental updates but has more complex management?
explain: **Block-Level**: موفر وأسرع وتدريجي، بس إدارته أعقد.
